answer_1.quote: We test the proposed approach with three benchmarks including the Ubuntu Dialogue Corpus, DailyDialog, and PERSONA-CHAT... Evaluation results on all three datasets indicate that our model can significantly outperform state-of-the-art generation models in terms of both automatic evaluation and human judgment.
models: Our simple transformer model with auxiliary tasks

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of the models in terms of response quality with both automatic metrics and human judgment.

answer_4.quote: In human evaluation, we randomly sample 500 dialogues from each of the three test sets, and recruit 3 native speakers as human annotators... The annotators judge which response is better based on informativeness, consistency, and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two generated responses and select the better one according to informativeness, consistency, and fluency (or mark a tie).
